title: Warming up for the holiday weekend - NewsBreak
text: Tomorrow will be one more beautiful day with a break from the heat and humidity. Highs will be a couple degrees warmer than what we experienced today, but since not too bad. Expect the thermometer to climb close to 90 degrees, with the heat index only a pinch warmer. Skies will be sunny with rain chances looking slim to none. Heat and humidity make a noticeable return for the 4th. The feel-like forecast for the 4th, 5th, and 6th will fall between 90-100 degrees. It’ll be warm, but we’ve certainly had hotter Independence Days. It’s worth mentioning that for the 4th, there will be a chance of a pop shower for areas West of Hwy 65 in the afternoon. The vast majority of people will stay dry. Those unlucky ones who do see rain, thankfully, it won’t last long and shouldn’t ruin any sunset firework plans. Rain chances do start to ramp up once we get towards the end of the holiday weekend. The heat dome overhead will start to slide further to the east, which will open up the door for a wet weather highway to settle in. Starting Sunday and lingering until Wednesday, we will be locked into a soggier pattern, which will return multiple opportunities for additional rain showers. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to KOLR - OzarksFirst.com.
